messages:
Elaine: kicking off thread for StratusLink co-sell pilot with Northwind Bank. Partner asks about latency guarantees and SSO flow for demo environment.

Mike: quick context — Northwind needs <10ms P95 for chat completions and SOC2 compliance. They want an initial 2-week pilot with traffic ~5rps, then scale.

Sophie: noted. For latency we can propose Dedicated with reserved GPU pool and burst. Can hit ~8–10ms P95 on gpus with optimized kernels but depends on prompt length.

Ivan: pricing Q — do we quote hosted blended rate or dedicated reserved pricing for the pilot? Partner expects month-to-month pricing while they validate enterprise buy-in.

Elaine: StratusLink prefers a short committed window. Suggest we offer a promo reserved price for the 2-week pilot then switch to usage-based if they don't commit. @Sophie can you confirm minimum reserved units? :thinking_face:

Sophie: min reserved for predictable latency is 1x T4-equivalent pool (we price as RU=1). For a 2-week pilot we can offer RU=0.5 trial discount 40% (internal approved). That handles ~5rps typical prompt lengths.

Mike: security questionnaire items from Northwind — they asked about KMS/HSM, audit logs, VPC peering, SAML idp, and data retention policy. Any docs we can hand off to StratusLink?

Ivan: I uploaded the security brief earlier but here's the quick answers: KMS via customer-managed keys supported in Private; hosted uses customer keys via bring-your-own in roadmap (we can list as upcoming). Audit logs available in Console (60d retention by default). VPC peering supported on Dedicated + Private. SAML works with IdP; small snippet they asked for metadata: 

redwood-bot: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://console.redwood.ai/saml">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://console.redwood.ai/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Sophie: for pilot runbook we need: 1) test tenant + SSO config 2) sample prompt set 3) latency test harness (we can share k6 script) 4) rollback path to hosted model variant. I can draft the runbook and share with StratusLink.

Elaine: nice. Can we also include a short joint-arch diagram showing edge routing -> regional RT (<10ms path) -> dedicated pool fallback? Partner engineering wants a slide for their sales deck.

Ivan: I'll mock a simple diagram and drop PNG to the partner drive. Also tagging action items:
- Elaine: confirm pilot dates with StratusLink (owner: Elaine)
- Sophie: draft runbook + k6 script (owner: Sophie)
- Mike: pricing doc with RU promo and conversion terms (owner: Mike)
- Ivan: architecture slide + SAML metadata (owner: Ivan)

Elaine: meeting pencilled for Tue 10am PT for handoff and SSO test. Everyone good? :thumbsup:

Mike: good for me.

Sophie: good.

Ivan: will be there.

redwood-bot: Reminder: create partner ticket PRJ-4312 and attach runbook.
